name: Retro Radio Group
description: Retro paper-styled radio button panel with hard offset shadows, a moving scanline overlay, bouncing selection dot and jittering label on hover.
contents: Panel with a list of radio options, each with a hand-drawn circle and label
behavior: Hovered label jitters and takes the accent color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change panel background or border colors

needsCodeEdit.where: retro-bounce keyframes in the style block

fixed: Renders nothing until mounted on the client
Panel width is 320px capped to the container width
